title: The tangent-plane projection of a C² submanifold extends to a C¹ field on a neighbourhood
statement: Let N ⊆ ℝ^P be an embedded C² d-dimensional submanifold. Then there are an open set O ⊇ N and a map pr : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P), C¹ on O, with pr(z) equal to the orthogonal projection onto span(T_zN) (= T_zN) for every z ∈ N.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → ∃ (O : Set (Euclid P)) (pr : Euclid P → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P)), IsOpen O ∧ N ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 pr O ∧ ∀ z ∈ N, pr z = (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace N z)).starProjection
